declare

begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/08/2012. IM 8555
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else

 end if;
 -- End of change

 nullchk;
 validate_product_type('Y');

 -- SCR 15596 : Exclude products based on vserv_customer_products table. 
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(1) 
 INTO lv_num
 FROM vserv_customer_products vcp 
 WHERE :banner.hdr_date 
 BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date,:banner.hdr_date+1) 
 AND vcp.customer_id = :control_block.customer_id
 AND NVL(vcp.consignee_id,:control_block.s_consignee_id) = :control_block.s_consignee_id
 AND vcp.prod_type = :standing_order_items.product_type;
 
 IF lv_num > 0 THEN
 show_error_dist('3314'); -- Restricted product type
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END;
 -- SCR 155 96 :: End
 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT') then -- Added by Kishore on 05/08/2012. IM 8555
 :standing_order_items.eff_date := chp_sysdate;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 /* 08/04/2018 
 Manually update this trigger (do not re-inherit) 
 BANNER is subclassed from SBCLIB.fmb but SBC_BANNER trigger is similar to SRVLIB.
 */
 temp_warehouse varchar2(1);
 PROCEDURE SHOW_HINT Is
 new_item_msg varchar2(80);
 f_block varchar2(30) := GET_FORM_PROPERTY(name_in('system.current_form'),FIRST_NAVIGATION_BLOCK);
 f_item varchar2(80);
 begin
 f_item := f_block || '.' || get_block_property(f_block,FIRST_ITEM);
 loop
 exit when get_item_property(f_item,NAVIGABLE) = 'TRUE' ;
 f_item := f_block || '.' || get_item_property(f_item,NEXTITEM);
 end loop;
 default_value('TRUE','global.show_hint');
 If get_item_property(f_item,AUTO_HINT) = 'TRUE' and :global.show_hint = 'TRUE' then
 :global.show_hint := 'FALSE';
 new_item_msg := get_item_property(f_item,HINT_TEXT);
 message(substr(new_item_msg,1,80),no_acknowledge);
 end if;
 END; 
begin
 :global.code_scheme := '' ; --HCL Creating NULL assigned code scheme global variable .

 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.warehouse');

 -- IM:8600;06/26/2012
 validate_user_dist;
 
 begin
 select codabar_unit_scheme
 into :global.codabar_unit_scheme
 from vserv_institutions;
 --

 select warehouse_id
 into temp_warehouse
 from vserv_users
 where upper(user_id) = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid;
 
 select chapter_id,
 unit_scheme,
 decode(sign(nvl(ISBT_start_date, sysdate + 1) - sysdate), 1, 'C', 'I')
 into :GLOBAL.chapter_id, :GLOBAL.unit_scheme, :GLOBAL.current_barcode_default
 from vserv_chapters
 where chapter_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+10);
 

 IF :GLOBAL.warehouse is null THEN
 :GLOBAL.warehouse := temp_warehouse;
 END IF; 

 SHOW_HINT; 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0602'); /* no data for chapter */
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting chapter_id for user');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end; 
 ------

 -- Added on 02/16/2011; Timezone conversion code;
 declare
 v_local_time date;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :banner.hdr_date := v_local_time;
 :banner.hdr_time := to_char(v_local_time,'hh24:mi');
 else
 :banner.hdr_date := sysdate;
 :banner.hdr_time := to_char(sysdate,'hh24:mi');
 end if;
 end;
 ---------- 
----End Change 02/16/2011-- 
 
-- 
 default_value('UNKNOWN', 'global.program_version');
 :banner.prog_version:='Rel: ' ||:global.program_version;
--

 default_value('SYSTEM NAME','global.system_name');
 default_value('MODULE NAME','global.module_name');
--
 :banner.system_name :=
 lpad( :global.system_name, NVL(length(:global.system_name), 0) +
 floor((50 - NVL(length(:global.system_name), 0))/2),' ');
 :banner.module_name :=
 lpad( :global.module_name, NVL(length(:global.module_name), 0) +
 floor((50 - NVL(length(:global.module_name), 0))/2),' ');
--
 --10g display_field('banner.module_name','Bold-underline');
 :banner.prog_name :=
 substr(:system.current_form,instr(:system.current_form,'/',-1,1)+1,8);
 if substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,4) = 'OPS$'
 then
 :banner.user_id := substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5,6) ;
 else
 :banner.user_id := substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,6) ;
 end if;
--
 default_value ('N/A','global.db_id');
 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,1))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 :banner.db_id := :global.db_id;
 :banner.colon := ':';
--
 :BANNER.PROG_VERSION := BANNER_PROG_VERSION;
 default_value (' ','global.pick_id');
end ;
